description: This file defines the 'TellerWritePlatformService' interface, which provides methods for creating, modifying, deleting tellers, and managing cashier allocations within the teller service in the Fineract project.

classes.name: TellerWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining service operations for tellers, including creation, modification, deletion, and cashier allocation management.

methods.name: createTeller
methods.description: Creates a new teller based on the provided JsonCommand object.

methods.name: modifyTeller
methods.description: Modifies an existing teller identified by tellerId using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteTeller
methods.description: Deletes an existing teller identified by tellerId.

methods.name: allocateCashierToTeller
methods.description: Allocates a cashier to a teller with allocation details provided in the JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateCashierAllocation
methods.description: Updates an existing cashier's allocation to a teller.

methods.name: deleteCashierAllocation
methods.description: Deletes a cashier's allocation from a teller.

methods.name: allocateCashToCashier
methods.description: Allocates cash to a cashier based on details in the JsonCommand.

methods.name: settleCashFromCashier
methods.description: Settles cash from a cashier as per the provided JsonCommand.
